title: lamyra nivea
intro: Lamyra nivea, commonly known as White Lamyra, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Lamiaceae. It is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and is valued for its medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, digestive problems, and respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Lamyra nivea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
